meanings.context: to be the result of; used with "a"

m.t: Algunas de éstas chicas van a esperar que lo seas.
m.e: Some of these girls out here are gonna hope that you are.

m.t: Y esos tipos podrían echar abajo éstas... paredes, con sus propias manos.
m.e: And those guys could rip down these walls with their bare hands.

m.t: Así que, éstas son las fotos que tomé de la casa.
m.e: So, these are the photos I took of the flip house.

m.t: ¿Alguno de ustedes ha disparado una de éstas antes?
m.e: Either of you ever-- ever shot one of these before?

m.t: Con éstas, podrán deshacerse de los Elfos, de una vez por todas.
m.e: With these, you could get rid of the Elves, once and for all.

m.t: Vienen de la misma fábrica que éstas.
m.e: They're from the same factory as these.

m.t: El doctor dijo que ha trabajado con heridas como éstas, no son tan malas.
m.e: Oh, the doctor said workout injuries like this, um, they're not so bad.

m.t: Éstas son todas citas de la Biblia.
m.e: These are all quotations from the Bible.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #630800 by Leono; English translation #55036 by CK

m.t: La mayor parte de éstas son mías.
m.e: Most of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863624 by arh; English translation #6863394 by CK

m.t: ¿No son éstas para los niños?
m.e: Aren't these for children?

m.t: Traje a todas éstas personas importantes.
m.e: I brought all these... these are important people.

m.t: Un montón de éstas son mías.
m.e: A lot of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863613 by arh; English translation #6863404 by CK

m.t: La mitad de éstas son mías.
m.e: Half of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863600 by arh; English translation #6863388 by CK

m.t: Unas cuantas de éstas son mías.
m.e: A few of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863617 by arh; English translation #6863402 by CK

m.t: ¿No queréis una de éstas?
m.e: Don't you want one of these?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7872701 by arh; English translation #6102508 by CK

m.t: Tome, éstas son sus cosas.
m.e: Here, these are his things.

m.t: ¿Puedo tener una de éstas?
m.e: Can I have one of these?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863609 by arh; English translation #6863408 by CK

m.t: ¿Puede darme una de éstas?
m.e: Can I have one of these?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863610 by arh; English translation #6863408 by CK

m.t: Ninguna de éstas es mía.
m.e: Neither of these is mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863605 by arh; English translation #6863422 by CK

m.t: Ya tengo una de éstas.
m.e: I already have one of these.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7366082 by arh; English translation #5850731 by CK

m.t: Éstas son las gafas de Tom, no las mías.
m.e: These are Tom's glasses, not mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2895101 by lena17; English translation #2540429 by CK

m.t: Algunas de éstas son mías.
m.e: Some of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863620 by arh; English translation #6863398 by CK

m.t: Éstas son opiniones completamente distintas.
m.e: These are completely different opinions.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #701542 by darinmex; English translation #392531 by CM

m.t: Éstas no eran así.
m.e: These were not them.

m.t: Éstas son las mías.
m.e: These are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6600556 by arh; English translation #2252705 by CK

m.t: Todas éstas son mías.
m.e: All of these are mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6863641 by arh; English translation #6863376 by CK

m.t: Éstas son mis alumnas.
m.e: These are my students.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7305812 by arh; English translation #2547056 by CK

m.t: - ¿Quieres una de éstas?
m.e: - Want some of these?

m.t: Le debo a ella todo lo que sé.
m.e: I owe everything I know to her.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1056273 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1359312 by marcelostockle

m.t: Yo le debo mi éxito a su ayuda.
m.e: I owe my success to his help.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1264963 by marcelostockle; English translation #251286 by CK

m.e: I owe two months' rent for my room.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #708102 by darinmex; English translation #261574 by CK

m.t: Debo disculparme por no haber escrito durante tanto tiempo.
m.e: I must apologize for not having written for such a long time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #855328 by Daga007; English translation #54730 by CK

m.t: Me dijo lo que debo hacer tras su muerte.
m.e: He told me what I should do after his death.

m.t: Dígame todo lo que debo saber.
m.e: Tell me everything I should know.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10303954 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #9345062 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Debo salir de aquí hoy.
m.e: I must leave here today.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1298244 by marcelostockle; English translation #253390 by CK

m.t: ¿Debo irme de una vez?
m.e: Must I leave at once?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #736037 by ventana; English translation #52168 by \N

m.t: Debo encontrar a mi amigo.
m.e: I must find my friend.

m.t: Debo pensar si es realmente bueno para mí.
m.e: I must think over whether it is really good for me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10078842 by manufrutos; English translation #10078479 by maaster

m.t: Debo tener eso para consolarme si no tengo nada más.
m.e: I must have that to comfort me if I have nothing else.

m.t: No estoy seguro de lo que debería hacer.
m.e: I'm not sure what I should do.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1232970 by Shishir; English translation #1230878 by CK

m.t: Debo hacer lo que se debería haber hecho hace mucho tiempo.
m.e: I must do what should have been done long ago.

m.t: Me debes 5 dólares más.
m.e: You owe me another $5.

m.t: Debes hacer el mayor esfuerzo posible en cualquier cosa que hagas.
m.e: You should make as much effort as possible in whatever you do.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2700838 by emanuel81; English translation #24728 by CK

m.t: Tú te debes quedar aquí hasta que ellos regresen.
m.e: You are to stay here till they return.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1181082 by marcelostockle; English translation #69009 by CM

m.t: Si quieres salir adelante en la vida, debes trabajar más duro.
m.e: If you are to get ahead in life, you must work harder.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7917982 by fpp; English translation #271087 by AlanF_US

m.t: Debes tener suficiente ahora, Michael, para volver a casa.
m.e: You must have enough now, Michael, to go back home.

m.t: Debes tener cuidado nadando en el mar.
m.e: You must be careful when swimming in the sea.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #760201 by darinmex; English translation #22256 by csabus

m.t: Debes vivir tu vida lo mejor que puedas.
m.e: You must live your life the best you can.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5304300 by ArtVel; English translation #3825921 by CK

m.t: Debes tomar en cuenta el hecho de que ella estaba enferma.
m.e: You must take into account the fact that she was ill.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1181073 by marcelostockle; English translation #68994 by CM

m.t: Debemos dejar de decir eso.
m.e: We gotta stop saying that.

m.t: Debemos cortar su poder.
m.e: We should cut their power.

m.t: Ambos estamos haciendo lo que debemos para salvar al mundo.
m.e: We're both doing what we must to save the world.

m.t: Debemos tener en cuenta a nuestra mascota a la hora de hacer un viaje.
m.e: We must take our pet into account when we make a trip.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1001021 by Shishir; English translation #249484 by \N

m.t: Debemos hacer algo para detener esta locura.
m.e: We must do something to stop this madness.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13658292 by Seael; English translation #7117513 by CM

m.t: O tú o yo debemos ir en su lugar.
m.e: Either you or I must go in his place.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3817806 by cueyayotl; English translation #17831 by Zifre

m.t: Debemos aceptar la vida, para bien o para mal.
m.e: We must accept life, for good or for evil.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #853346 by krash; English translation #270600 by \N

m.t: Deberías dar un buen ejemplo a tus hijos.
m.e: You should set a good example to your children.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1428254 by peibolvig; English translation #245621 by CK

m.t: Quieres respuestas a preguntas que no deberías hacer.
m.e: You want answers to questions you shouldn't ask.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #671634 by darinmex; English translation #671633 by darinmex

m.t: A ella ustedes no le deben nada.
m.e: You don't owe her anything.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10534609 by Seael; English translation #3911191 by CH

m.t: Te dije, las mujeres no deben beberla.
m.e: I told you, women shouldn't drink that.

m.t: Estas medicinas se deben tomar tres vezes al día.
m.e: These medicines should be taken three times a day.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4940449 by Estebitan; English translation #522223 by nickyeow

m.t: En esta escuela, los niños deben utilizar el inglés.
m.e: In this school, the children must use English.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9130918 by carlosalberto; English translation #9130902 by carlosalberto

m.t: Los niños no deben pasar demasiado tiempo frente a las pantallas.
m.e: Children must not spend too much time in front of screens.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8872806 by carlosalberto; English translation #8872798 by carlosalberto

m.t: Los estudiantes deben guardar silencio durante la clase.
m.e: Students must keep silent during class.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1552556 by marcelostockle; English translation #21367 by kindpanda

m.t: Deben haber llegado a casa sobre esta hora.
m.e: They must have arrived home by this time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #862783 by felipeselles; English translation #306563 by CS

m.t: Deben haber sabido que alguien ... sería tratar de encontrarlo.
m.e: They must have known that someone would... would try to find it.

m.t: Un amigo que le debía un favor a mi esposo muerto.
m.e: A friend who owed my dead husband a favor.

m.t: No sabía cómo debía responder a su pregunta.
m.e: I didn't know how to answer his question.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #963883 by Shishir; English translation #260642 by CK

m.t: El tipo que maneja su dinero me debía un favor.
m.e: The guy that manages her money owed me favor.

m.t: Afortunadamente, él no le debía ningún dinero a nadie.
m.e: Fortunately, he didn't owe anyone any money.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #14013710 by mervert1; English translation #14013623 by zogwarg

m.t: Yo no estaba seguro de lo que se supone que debía hacer.
m.e: I wasn't sure what I was supposed to do.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10179340 by Jeigmz; English translation #5700953 by CK

m.t: Para ser senador de Roma, tu padre debía ser senador.
m.e: To be a Senator in Rome, your father had to be a Senator.

m.t: De repente me di cuenta de que debía aprender polaco.
m.e: All of a sudden, I realized I must learn Polish.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1775122 by marcelostockle; English translation #1775043 by Dejo

m.t: - Le dije que debía haber algún error.
m.e: - I told him there must be some mistake.

m.t: Pensé que debía ser algo así.
m.e: I thought it must be something like that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2129484 by marcelostockle; English translation #1961349 by CK

m.t: Además, todos los que deberían saberlo, lo saben.
m.e: Besides, anyone who needs to know, knows.

m.t: Médicos y enfermeras deberían preservar la vida a toda costa.
m.e: Doctors and nurses must preserve life at all costs.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1483546 by wallebot; English translation #28072 by frpzzd

m.t: Debí haber tenido fe en mí y no la tuve.
m.e: I should have had faith in myself, and I didn't.

m.t: ¡Jamás debió haber ido en primer lugar!
m.e: She should never have gone in the first place!
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2042126 by labatteg; English translation #1881748 by sundown

m.t: Aquello debió ser una pesadilla para ti, porque tú querías a tu padre.
m.e: That must've been a nightmare for you, 'cause you love your dad.

m.t: Alguien que sabe bien inglés debió haberlo escrito.
m.e: Someone who knows English well must have written this.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5762664 by Lalourquieta; English translation #26233 by CK

m.t: Tu familia debió sentirse muy orgullosa de tu premio.
m.e: Your folks must have been so proud of your award.

m.t: Debiste haber ido a México con tu chica.
m.e: You should have gone to Mexico with your chica.

m.t: Debiste crecer en una familia muy buena.
m.e: You must've been raised in a really nice family. You know?

m.t: Pero esta vez no siento que deba disculparme.
m.e: But this time... I don't feel like I need to apologize.

m.t: No quiero que alguien como tú me deba todo este dinero.
m.e: I don't want someone like you to owe me this much money.

m.t: Quieres poner a alguien en ese asiento... alguien que te deba, no alguien que esté comprometido.
m.e: You wanna put someone in that seat... someone who'll owe you, not someone who's compromised.

m.t: Chicos, no creo que eso deba estar allí.
m.e: Guys, I don't think that belongs there.

m.t: La muerte no es algo a lo que se deba temer.
m.e: Death is nothing to fear.

m.t: Sí, haga lo que crea que deba hacer.
m.e: Yes, you do what you feel you must.

m.t: Por cada alma que liberen tus amigos, uno de ellos deberá quedarse.
m.e: For every soul your friends free, one of them is going to have to stay.

m.t: El anillo deberá estar aquí en cualquier momento.
m.e: The ring should be here any day now.

m.t: Bajo ninguna circumstancia deberá usted enviar tropas.
m.e: Under no circumstances are you to send in troops.

m.t: Sea verdad o no, este hombre deberá limpiarme el culo.
m.e: True or false? This man has to wipe my ass.

m.t: Mi coche deberá estar reparado en pocos días.
m.e: I must have my car fixed in a few days.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1097555 by arashi_29; English translation #258213 by CM

m.t: Por lo que dice, no creo que debamos ir.
m.e: From what he says, I don't think we should go.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2253334 by cueyayotl; English translation #2253333 by _undertoad

m.t: No sé lo que se supone que debamos de hacer con esto.
m.e: I don't know what we're supposed to do with it.

m.t: No estoy segura de que debamos.
m.e: I'm not sure that we do.

m.t: Por supuesto que podría haber usado ese dinero que me debías.
m.e: Course I could use that money you owed me.

m.t: Te pusiste en contra de la institución a la que debías servir.
m.e: You've turned your back on the very institution you were meant to serve.

m.t: ¿No me debías algo de dinero?
m.e: Didn't you owe me some money?

m.t: Además, espero que no hayas olvidado que debías trabajar hoy.
m.e: Also, I hope you didn't forget that you're supposed to be working today.

m.t: ¡Debías tener ese dinero a toda costa!
m.e: You had to get that money at all costs!

m.t: ¡Ni siquiera debías estar aquí!
m.e: You weren't even supposed to be here!

m.t: Yo creí que debías tener al menos 80 años para ser abogado.
m.e: I thought you had to be, like, at least 80 to be a lawyer.

m.t: Debías sentirte como en una piscina todos los días.
m.e: You must have felt like you were at the pool all day.

m.t: ¡Y estaremos juntos de la forma en que debimos estarlo!
m.e: And we're gonna be together the way we were meant to be!

m.t: ¡Sabía que debimos haber ido a la policía cuando todo esto comenzó!
m.e: I knew we should have gone to the cops when this all started!

m.t: Debimos haber perdido nuestros recuerdos.
m.e: We must have lost our memories.

m.t: No, dime lo que debas decirme, yo solo... seguiré trabajando.
m.e: No, say what you got to say. I just... I'm gonna keep working.

m.t: Haz lo que debas.
m.e: You do what you must.

m.t: No estoy seguro de que debas estar aquí.
m.e: I'm not sure you're supposed to be in here.

m.t: No debieron haber gastado tanto dinero en su pasatiempo.
m.e: You ought not to have spent so much money on your hobby.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1835993 by marcelostockle; English translation #16007 by Swift

m.t: Ahora bien, debieron hacer algo porque no regresaron con ellas.
m.e: Now, they must've done something with them because they didn't come back with them.

m.t: Ellos debieron saber que mis palabras eran solo eso.
m.e: They must've known my words were just that.

m.t: Se suponía que debían fallar unas cuantas respuestas a propósito.
m.e: You were supposed to miss a few answers on purpose.

m.t: Así que tal vez volvió allí porque le debían algo de dinero.
m.e: So maybe you did go back there because they owed you some money.

m.t: Dijeron que no pagarían a la gente el dinero que les debían.
m.e: They said he would not pay people the money he owed them.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1335687 by Shishir; English translation #802730 by Source_VOA

m.t: Les prometió que no debían preocuparse por París.
m.e: And he promised them that they needn't worry about Paris.

m.t: Debían tenerla en el submarino.
m.e: They must have had her on the submarine.

m.t: Las mujeres no debían hacerlo.
m.e: Women are not supposed to do it.

m.t: Todos los delegados sabían que debían debatirlo.
m.e: All the delegates knew they must discuss it.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5129961 by albrusgher; English translation #802609 by Source_VOA

m.t: Los federales debían saber en qué andaba metido.
m.e: Feds must've known what he was up to.

m.t: A ella no le debéis nada.
m.e: You don't owe her anything.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10534606 by Seael; English translation #3911191 by CH

m.t: Se supone que debéis saber de estás cosas.
m.e: You're supposed to know about this stuff.

m.t: En clase no debéis hablar los unos con los otros.
m.e: You must not talk to each other in class.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2429501 by Shishir; English translation #266234 by CK

m.t: Al que de verdad debéis temer es al que está más cerca.
m.e: The one you must truly fear is the one who is closest.

m.t: En nuestro tipo de trabajo, siempre debéis asumir que alguien os observa.
m.e: In our line of work, you must always assume someone is watching.

m.t: Decidimos, como sea que pudiéramos, debíamos volver a la isla.
m.e: We decided, in whatever capacity we could, we would give ourselves back to the island.

m.t: Te dije que debíamos tomar la línea azul.
m.e: I told you! I told you that we had to get on the Blue Line.

m.t: Asumí que había algo más que debíamos hacer.
m.e: I assumed there must be something else we had to do.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2314584 by marcelostockle; English translation #2293271 by CK

m.t: No, me deberás una botella, amigo.
m.e: No, you'll owe me a bottle, pal.

m.t: Y me deberás una.
m.e: And you're gonna owe me one.

m.t: No me deberás nada.
m.e: You don't owe me anything.

m.t: Y tú deberás regresar a tu casa y hogar... con mi bendición.
m.e: And you shall have back your hearth and home... With my blessing.

m.t: Si deseas salvar la vida de tu amado, deberás matar a tu hijo.
m.e: If you want to save the life of your love, you must kill your son.

m.t: Y cuando llores a tu padre, también deberás llorar a otra persona.
m.e: And while you mourn your father, you must also mourn someone else.

m.t: Si deseas volver a tu hogar, deberás encontrar otras maneras.
m.e: If you wish to return home, you must find other means.

m.t: Eso significa que todos los socios capitalistas deberán 300.000 más este año.
m.e: That means all the equity partners will owe $300,000 more this year.

m.t: Nuestros invitados deberán estar aquí dentro de una hora.
m.e: Our guests should be here within an hour.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1534977 by arashi_29; English translation #64659 by CK

m.t: Para el siguiente deberán permanecer muy callados porque harán algo muy malo.
m.e: For this next one, you need to be very, very quiet. Because you're about to do something very wrong.

m.t: Los postulantes deberán hacer la solicitud en persona.
m.e: Applicants are requested to apply in person.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #853418 by abu3; English translation #246201 by CK

m.t: - Deberán pensar que se están moviendo en
m.e: - They shall think you're moving in.

m.t: No te saqué de ahí porque te debiera una.
m.e: - I didn't get you out of there because you pulled one over on me.

m.t: Me siento como si te debiera una disculpa.
m.e: I feel like I owe you an apology.

m.t: No creí que te debiera una respuesta.
m.e: I didn't think I owed you an answer.

m.t: No estoy seguro de que debiera estar aquí.
m.e: I'm not sure you should be here.

m.t: Sí, algo que no creo que nadie debiera haber visto.
m.e: Yeah, something I don't think anybody was supposed to see.

m.t: Bueno, quieres uno de los míos, porque tengo tres.
m.e: Well, do you want one of mine, 'cause I had three.

m.t: Estos libros son míos y esos son de él.
m.e: These books are mine and those books are his.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3010905 by wallebot; English translation #55085 by Nihonkage

m.t: Si quieren hacerme un enemigo, entonces ellos serán los míos.
m.e: If they want to make an enemy of me, then I will make them mine.

m.t: Si es uno de los míos, podría ayudar.
m.e: If it's one of mine, I might be able to help.

m.t: Sin duda alguna, esos no son amigos míos.
m.e: Those are definitely not friends of mine.

m.t: Este perro y ese pez son míos, pero aquel pájaro no.
m.e: This dog and that fish are mine, but that bird not.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1646948 by wallebot; English translation #1646964 by wallebot

m.t: Y yo espero, que usted nunca necesite los míos.
m.e: And I hope, you'll never need mine.

m.t: Tus brazos son más largos que los míos.
m.e: Your arms are longer than mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4916978 by Shishir; English translation #3831487 by CK

m.t: Tus ingresos son sobre el doble de grandes que los míos.
m.e: Your income is about twice as large as mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1238488 by wallebot; English translation #17067 by Zifre

m.t: Sus abuelos y los míos vinieron del mismo país.
m.e: Your grandparents and mine came from the same country.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #987226 by Shishir; English translation #13023417 by araneo

m.t: Tus ingresos son tres veces mayores que los míos.
m.e: Your income is three times larger than mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1318334 by Shishir; English translation #17069 by Zifre

m.t: Tus problemas se parecen a los míos.
m.e: Your problems are similar to mine.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3270364 by Shishir; English translation #2663157 by CK

m.t: Él no siempre encuentra los míos.
m.e: He doesn't always find mine.

m.t: Tus zapatos están aquí. ¿Dónde están los míos?
m.e: Your shoes are here. Where are mine?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1279718 by Shishir; English translation #17264 by Swift

m.t: ¿Estos son sus libros? "No, no son míos".
m.e: Are these your books? "No, they're not mine."
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5303528 by baudelaire; English translation #5341066 by Amittai

m.t: Bueno, sí, ya sabes, tiene esas fotos mías.
m.e: - Well, yeah, you know, he's got these photos of me.

m.e: He took one of my things the other day.

m.e: Why the fuck are you sending pictures of me while I'm asleep to the Dark Army?

m.e: I'll show you mine if you show me yours.
